programmes.d: A teacher steps in when an outlaw influences a youngster.
A Union naval officer tries to curb the activities of a group of Southern sympathizers in California.
A woman comes to the rescue of her husband, trapped in a mine by outlaws during the gold rush in California.
A man seeking to open a saloon turns to Harry Bassett, Wyatt Earp and Bat Masterson for help.
Lt. Wood is stationed in Arizona Territory during an Apache uprising and illness breaks out among the Natives.
A nun who tries to help an injured boy finds herself in trouble with the law.
Jim Badger learns the meaning of 3-7-77 the hard way — from a crooked lawman and a vigilante committee.
As the Donner Party attempts to cross the Sierra Nevada Mountains, and the Reed family is banished.
A drama about the working conditions in a mining town.
An ex-con tries to prevent the son he gave up for adoption from following in his steps.
Yvonne DeCarlo plays a doctor struggling to begin a medical practice as a woman in the 1890s.
The Salt War erupts when a rancher decides to sell salt that used to be free.
Matt Denby faces severe bad luck: his farm fails, his son is bitten by a rabid animal and his wife leaves him.
The mayor of Austin once insulted Bill. Now, Bill is the governor of Texas — and eager for revenge.
A ghost-plagued woman hires a detective to take her and her fortune to San Francisco.
A tenderfoot teams with a prospector who is quick to live up to his reputation as a jinx.
A greedy merchant creates panic by spreading rumors that the town's supply lines are cut off by snow.
Dr. Allen Camden investigates the murder of likeable shopkeeper Grant Noble.
Trapper Joe Meek uses his persuasive powers to garner votes for the U.S. annexation of the Oregon Territory.
A group of religious settlers tangles with outlaws who have set up an illegal tollgate.
Lawyer William Thorne defends an innocent woman threatened by bigotry and mob violence in an Arizona town.
When Claypool swindles McSween out of his gold mine, storekeeper Hobart has an idea for retribution.
Phillip Sheridan's friendship with Native scout Kahlu is questioned after ambushes leave troopers dead.
A con artist boasts he owns most of San Francisco, but a chemist aims to expose him.
Patriotism and banditry clash when Owens, along with companion Delores, are captured by outlaw Juan Cortina.
When five men desert the Union Army, they are at the mercy of General Avery, who favors shooting them.
Lucas receives a series of mysterious threatening notes from an ex-convict with a grudge.
After shooting a man in self-defense, Andy Moon turns to Lucas for protection from the man's vengeful brothers.
To keep his invalid mother happy, an outlaw forces Lucas and Mark to go along with a masquerade that he is the owner of Lucas's ranch.
A sharecropper enters his colt in a horse race hoping to win enough money to buy his farm from the owner who has bet on Mark McCain's entry.
When Lucas hires an ex-con as a ranch hand, the man is the first one under suspicion when a robbery and murder occur in the area.
Lucas helps his former Army captain, now an undercover federal agent, infiltrate a gang of bank robbers.
Lucas finds himself involved in murder when he gallantly steps to the aid of a beautiful woman.
An ex-convict is blamed for a brutal crime despite his claims of rehabilitation.
Lucas is out for vengeance when Mark is used as a pawn in a bank robbery scheme.
Lucas shoots a horse thief who turns out to be a member of the Boyle clan. Now Ma Boyle is after him.
Seven condemned murderers escape and take over the town of North Fork.
When Mark finds gold on their property, a fast-talking salesman who tried to sell Lucas a new lightning rod offers instead to buy the ranch's mineral rights.
Lucas tracks an escaped prisoner to a town that turns out to be run by the gunman's brother who is notorious for shooting people in the back.
When an outlaw leader lures Marshall Torrance out of town, Only Lucas can stop him from lynching a local man who killed one of the members of his gang.
A former army captain comes to North Fork to kill the man who shot down his son in a gunfight - Lucas McCain.
Mark and his friend become trapped in an old mine.
A new store owner upsets the town by demanding all credit accounts be paid off.
Annie and Tagg meet Tim Lafferty, a strange old Irishman who claims to be searching for treasure with the help of leprechauns who followed him to America from the Auld Country.
A young doctor returns to Diablo. Unknown to his father, the son fell in with bad company while at school and owes a crooked gambler a large sum of money.

While rummaging through an old trunk, Tagg and his friend Johnny Ward, the son of a murdered lawman, find evidence that they believe proves his uncle is an ex-convict and may be part of the outlaw gang who recently robbed Diablo's bank.
The federal government tells Choctaw tribes to move from Mississippi to Arkansas, but one tribe refuses because the chief's son is sick.
